item.title: Kensington Gardens shut after claims of drones near Israeli embassy
item.summary: It comes after a group claimed to have targeted the Israeli Embassy in an online video post.

item.title: How two ceasefires and 'opening' of Hormuz could boost Iran talks
item.summary: Some kind of diplomatic progress is now under way, but is it enough to prevent a return to war?

item.title: Oil prices plunge as Iran says Strait of Hormuz 'open' during ceasefire
item.summary: Brent crude sinks by a tenth after Iran says the key waterway is open for commercial ships for the rest of the ceasefire.

item.title: Former Radio 1 DJ and Live Aid presenter Andy Kershaw dies aged 66
item.summary: The broadcaster was known for his eclectic taste and for helping champion world music on BBC Radio 1.

item.title: Irish fugitive and alleged crime boss Daniel Kinahan arrested in Dubai
item.summary: Kinahan, in his 40s, was arrested in Dubai on foot of an arrest warrant issued by the Irish courts.

item.title: No evidence Epsom rape took place as reported, say police
item.summary: The reported attack had caused concern and prompted protests calling for more details from police.

item.title: Some Iran-linked ships have crossed US blockade, data suggests
item.summary: At least four vessels tracked from Iranian ports appear to have crossed a US blockade line in the Gulf of Oman, analysis of ship-tracking data suggests.

item.title: Ceasefire with Israel brings respite to Lebanon, but obstacles to peace remain
item.summary: The halt to weeks of fighting is being celebrated in Lebanon, but it will be difficult to ensure it lasts.

item.title: Key questions facing government over Mandelson checks
item.summary: It's emerged that Lord Mandelson did not pass inital security vetting checks ahead of taking up the role of ambassador to the United States.

item.title: Man guilty of 2003 rape that saw innocent Andrew Malkinson jailed for 17 years
item.summary: Paul Quinn, 52, is found guilty of the rape for which Andrew Malkinson was jailed for 17 years.
